Settings_Notes_Desc_ReadMoreMaxCharacter: When a Note's body exceeds this character count, it is collapsed behind a "Read more" toggle.
Settings_Notes_Desc_ReadMoreMaxLines: When a Note's body contains more newlines than this, it is collapsed behind a "Read more" toggle.
Settings_Notes_ThreadCollapseDesc: When a reply chain (thread) exceeds a certain length, the middle posts are omitted and shown as a dotted line. Omitted posts cannot be re-expanded in the timeline, but remain viewable from their own individual detail page.
Settings_Notes_Desc_ThreadCollapseThresh: When a thread's post count exceeds this number, the middle posts are collapsed.
Settings_Notes_Desc_TailVisibleCount: How many posts stay visible at the start and at the end when collapsed.
Settings_Notes_Desc_ConnectorLineLength: Height of the dotted vertical line shown for a collapsed section.
Settings_Notes_Desc_DashLength: Length of each dash making up the collapsed section's vertical line.
Settings_Notes_TimelineLoadingDesc: Controls how many posts the main timeline loads at once, both on first display and each time you scroll near the bottom (infinite scroll). Posts hidden by thread collapse do not count toward this number.
Settings_Notes_Desc_TimelinePageSize: Number of visible timeline posts loaded initially, and loaded again each time you scroll close to the bottom.
Settings_Notes_AppearanceDesc: Set the font size, text color, background color, and URL/hashtag colors for every piece of text the Notes tab displays (body, header, timestamps, quoted-note preview, attachment counts, and the Trash view). These settings are independent of Settings > Theme and Settings > Fonts - changing those has no effect on Notes.
Settings_Notes_Desc_BodyFontSize: Font size for all text Notes displays.
Settings_Notes_Desc_BodyTextColor: Text color for all text Notes displays.
Settings_Notes_Desc_UrlColor: Text color for clickable URLs inside a Note's body.
Settings_Notes_Desc_HashtagColor: Text color for clickable hashtags inside a Note's body.
Settings_Notes_ImagesDesc: Configure the thumbnail size and where attached images render within a posted Note.
Settings_Notes_Desc_ThumbnailSize: Side length (px) of an attachment thumbnail shown on a Note card and while composing a New Note.
Settings_Notes_Desc_ImageDisplayMode: Whether attached images render together at the bottom of the article (Attachment List) or at the position within the text where they were attached (Inline).
Settings_Notes_Desc_MaxRenderedThumbnail: Number of attachment thumbnails rendered on a Note card before the rest collapse into a "+N" count.
Settings_Chart_Drawing_ShiftClickHint: Shift + Left Click: Deletes the drawing tool under the cursor (or finalizes the shape currently being drawn).
Settings_Chart_Drawing_CtrlClickHint: Ctrl + Left Click: For tools with no fixed number of points, finalizes the shape with the last placed control point as its endpoint. Always returns to the Pointer tool afterward, even when Continue Drawing is enabled.
Settings_Chart_Drawing_AltKeyHint: Alt (while drawing): Prevents the drawing tool from snapping to other drawing tools or to chart data (e.g. candles).
Settings_Chart_StrokeThickness_Desc: Sets the default line thickness for newly created drawing tools.
Settings_Chart_DrawingDefaultColor_Desc: Default color for newly created drawing tools (lines, shapes, annotations).
Settings_Chart_DrawingHandleColor_Desc: Color for anchor point circles on selected drawing objects.
Settings_Chart_DrawingAnchorPointColor_D: Highlight color for a drawing object's reference/anchor control point (the pivot used for rotation and extension-line operations). By default the start point (first clicked point) is the anchor.
Settings_Chart_DrawingFontSize_Desc: Font size for auto-generated text labels in drawing tools (Fibonacci, Elliott Wave, Angle, etc.).
Settings_Chart_SmartGuidesEnabled_Desc: Automatically snap objects to edges and centers of other objects during move and resize operations.
Settings_Chart_SmartGuideSnapThreshold_D: Pixel distance threshold to trigger smart guide snapping and alignment line rendering (default: 5.0px).
Settings_Chart_ControlPointHideTimeout_D: Seconds of no pointer activity before a selected drawing tool's control points auto-hide (default: 5s).
Settings_Chart_DrawingToolContinuationMo: For tools with a fixed start/end point (e.g. Trend Line, Rectangle), what happens once the last point is placed.
Settings_Chart_RoundingMode_Desc: Select the mathematical method for aligning prices to a grid. Affects Renko, Kagi, and P&F charts.
Settings_Chart_Renko_Desc: Renko charts filter out noise by focusing solely on price movement using fixed brick sizes.
Settings_Chart_Candlestick_Desc: Configure the visual appearance of standard candlestick charts.
Settings_Chart_OHLCBar_Desc: Configure the visual appearance of OHLC (Open-High-Low-Close) bar charts.
Settings_Chart_Kagi_Desc: Kagi charts highlight trend reversals based on price movement regardless of time.
Settings_Chart_Pnf_Desc: Point & Figure charts ignore time and volume, focusing only on significant price changes and trend reversals.
Settings_Chart_Line_Desc: Configure the visual appearance of line charts.
Settings_Chart_Area_Desc: Configure the visual appearance of area charts.
Settings_Chart_HeikinAshi_Desc: Configure the visual appearance of Heikin Ashi charts.
Settings_Chart_ThreeLineBreak_Desc: Three Line Break charts focus on price reversals by requiring a break of the previous three lines' highs or lows.
Settings_Chart_RelativePerformance_Desc: Compare the performance of multiple tickers on a relative basis. Percentage Change, Ratio, or Z-Score (Standardized) can be displayed.
Settings_Chart_ReverseWatch_Desc: Plots the correlation between price and volume on a 2D plane to visualize market cycles (Phase 1-8).
PythonSetup_Message:
Python execution environment is not configured.

A Python environment is required to use advanced indicators and data synchronization features.
Would you like to automatically download and set up the embedded Python environment?
(This will take 1–2 minutes and requires an internet connection.)

*Select 'Configure Manually' if you wish to set up Python yourself.
PythonSetup_Manual_Instructions:
[Manual Setup Instructions]

1. Prepare a Python 3.8-3.11 environment. (Using a virtual environment is recommended to avoid conflicts.)
2. Open a command prompt, navigate to the root directory of this project, and install the dependencies:
   pip install -r StockAnalyzer.Python/requirements.txt
3. Open the [StockAnalyzer.Avalonia/appsettings.json] file, and append the absolute path to your python.exe in the [PythonPath] key under the [Python] section.

   Example:
   "Python": {
     "PythonPath": "C:\\path\\to\\python.exe"
   }

*Please restart the application after completing the setup.
PythonUpdate_Message:
Python environment is configured. Would you like to check for and install updates for the required Python libraries?
(Select 'Configure Manually' to view manual update instructions.)
PythonUpdate_Manual_Instructions:
[Manual Update Instructions]

1. Open a command prompt, navigate to the root directory of this project, and run the following command to update libraries:
   pip install -r StockAnalyzer.Python/requirements.txt --upgrade
2. Restart the application to apply the changes.
